question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Queue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for **blank No. 1** is: **queue.**
 
• In the given context, the word "**queue**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It refers to a line of people waiting for their turn, typically in a specific order. In this case, the sentence suggests that the queue (line) at the bank was endless, meaning there were many people waiting.
 
• Example sentence with the correct word:
 
 
• "Of course, the **queue **was endless, and he got stuck behind two women."
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer for blank No. 1 is 1) queue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not convey the intended meaning in the given context:
 
 
• **progression**: This word does not fit the context of waiting in line or the sense of an endless line.
 
• **passage**: This word refers to a path or route and does not accurately convey the idea of waiting in a line.
 
• **chain**: This word typically refers to a series of connected links or objects and is not suitable in the context of waiting in a line.
